instruction: Export a PowerDNS zone to a standard zone file

; PowerDNS zone dump
; Zone: example.com
; SOA serial: 2024072501
@               IN  SOA     a.example.com. hostmaster.example.com. (
                    2024072501 ; serial
                    3600       ; refresh
                    900        ; retry
                    604800     ; expire
                    3600       ; minimum
                    )
@               IN  NS      a.iana-servers.net.
@               IN  NS      b.iana-servers.net.
@               IN  A       93.184.216.34
mail            IN  A       93.184.216.35
www             IN  A       93.184.216.36
@               IN  MX      10 mail.example.com.
